description: Return a link when the client prefers to complete a website form, using comparison_id from the comparison. No contact details, lead or email are sent. For a client who asks you to send the request in this conversation, use request_adviser_contact after explicit consent instead. Swiss Premium Insurance assistance is optional; clients may apply directly with insurers.
